content: Noquen xenibo nincamanoxon ta hicha coti jahuen joi Papan jato nincamanishqui, mesco yonotiyahpaxon. Jahuen joi yohinicaboyaxon jato yohiquin.
Noquen xohtabo nincamanixon ta nete queyoyaxahnon jahuen baqueyabixon sca noque nincamanishqui. Jaa jahuen baqueyaxon jatihibi hahmenonixon ta jatihibi rihbi jaan hihbojanon Papan yohinishqui.

Jahuen xaba jenquetsahpa quin hihxon xaba jisxon non honanai quescajaribiquin ta Papan shinan jenquetsahpa quin hihxon jahuen baque yohuanai nincaxon non honanscai. Noquen Papa jenquetsahpa quin hihxon tah non jahuen baque jisxon non honan sca jai. Jascapahxon ta jahuen coshi shinaman yohixon jahuen baquen jatihibi hihmahiqui. Jaan hihmayamahah cahen queyotan. Noquen hohcha sohuahax ta quiquin hihbo sca Papa patax tsahoscaiqui, jatihibichin hihbo sca.
Jascapahax ta Papan yonotibo mentan hashoan coshi qui. Papan yonotibo ta Papa betan hahbe shinanyahpa ma qui, yonoti cahron. Papan baque ca hahbe shinanyahpa. Jaa copi ta Baquen hahquiqui.

content.text: Mia tah min heen baque qui. Baquen hah sca tah hen mia jai

content: hihqui jaa huisha. Jahuen yonotibo ta quenaquin jascajayamanishqui, jahuen baque huesti. Huetsa jahuen huisha ta nesca qui:

content.text: Hea tah hen jahuen Papa hihtihi, jaa rihbi heen baque hihnon

content: Huetsa janin rihbi ta jahuen baque beboquiha yohihi nea huisha jaiqui:

content.text: Jaa bebon ta Papan yonotibo jatihibi raboxonen tisquihahpaqueyaxihquiqui

content: Jahuen yonotibo yohihi ta nescari yohuannishqui:

content.text: Jahuen yonotibo ta Mia nihuetanhue yohihiqui. Jahuen hahxontibo cahen chihi perehihmatanhue hahcan.
Jascabi sca tah min jatihi, Diosen quiquin hihbo. Miin hihboti ta jahuentianbi queyotimahiqui. Hahan ponteti shinaman tah min miin jihuetahbo jihuemahi.
Sirijahibo tah min siri jisi. Tiromajahibo tah min casticanai. Jaa copi ta Papa Dios miin Papa hihxon, mia hihti jenimamahiqui, caibo jenimaribinon bi mia rihbi sca hihti jenimahi
Mian tsahonah ta mai jamenonishqui, Hihbon. Miin mequemanbi tah min naijaniqui.
Coton payocanahi hihqui quescarihbihi ta jatihibi payotihiqui. Jaabo queyocahinyaxihqui bi mia queyoyamanox manatai.

Rahcoti hahcajaquin tah min jato sebibahinyaxihqui, coton cahtoquin hahcajaquin. Jascajaha ta huetsapahcahinyaxihcanihqui. Jaabo huetsapahi bi ta mia jascabiyaxihqui huetsapahyamahi. Mia tah min queyoyosma qui

content: Huetsa jascapa huisha rihbi ta jaiqui, jahuen yonotibo jan yohiyamahi bi jahuen baque jan yohihi nescari:

content.text: Hea mecayaho tsahotihue, nenohax jatihibi hihbonoxon. Miin rahuibo tah hen mia bihxontihi, namanjaquin miin hinabo sca jaahbo

content: hihqui jaa huisha joi, jahuen baque yohihi.
Jahuen yonotibo ta huetsabo qui. Jaabo jatihibi ta jahuen hahxonnicabo qui. Jahuen jihuetahbo yanapannon hihxon ta jato raanihqui.
